label: Sales Proposal Generator
description: Creates tailored sales proposals from opportunity data, customer context, and solution capabilities. Structures value proposition, approach, timeline, and commercial terms.

guidedInputs.label: Prospect / client name
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Swedbank AB, Siemens Financial Services

guidedInputs.label: Prospect context
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Describe the prospect:
- Industry and size
- Key challenges they have described
- Strategic priorities and pressures
- Key stakeholders involved
- What motivated them to evaluate a solution now (compelling event)

guidedInputs.label: Proposed solution / engagement scope
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Describe what you plan to propose:
- Services, products, or deliverables included
- Team composition (roles, seniority)
- Engagement model (fixed price, time & materials, retainer)
- Duration and phases
- What is explicitly out of scope

guidedInputs.label: Commercial terms
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., EUR 150,000 fixed price over 4 months, EUR 25,000/month retainer, Day rate EUR 2,500 for senior consultant, 30-day payment terms, 10% discount if signed by month end

guidedInputs.label: Our differentiators for this deal
guidedInputs.placeholder: What makes us distinctively suited to this engagement? Include: relevant case studies, specific expertise, team credentials, methodology advantages, client references in same industry

options.label: Formal and structured (large enterprise, regulated industry)
